name: Universal Construct Foundation
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. UCON-000001 legislates no ontology, mints no identity scheme, owns no existence vocabulary and certifies nothing. It binds to the authorities that already own each concern: UMK-000001 owns open-by-registration classification, UCOS-CEU-001 owns the existence and epistemic vocabularies, UCKP-ART-05 owns identity, UCXI-000001 owns context and location axes, CMG-000002 owns temporal coordinates, UOBC-000001 owns birth. What UCON-000001 adds is one thing no owner supplies: a total, traceable disposition for every presented construct, and a governed home for the unknown, the contradictory and the undecidable.
constitutional_superior: UMK-000001 (open-world classification) · UCOS-CEU-001 (existence and epistemic states) · UCKP-LAW-0001 Art-13 (canonical serialisation)
$why_this_exists: Measured, before this artifact: the repository could REFUSE an unknown construct (engine/kernel/errors.py::MetaTypeUnknownError), could REPORT a conflict as a recomputed three-string finding with no identity (engine/knowledge/intelligence.py::ConflictFinding), and could RECORD a non-closed measurement cell (engine/uicm/gap.py::Gap, which by its own docstring carries no status because 'a closure is only ever a measurement'). None of those is a governed home. A construct whose classifying kind was unregistered was rejected and left no record; a contradiction was derived on each run and stored nowhere; an unknown was a coercion-failure message. The foundational principle — that any presented construct can be represented, governed, traced and disposed without constitutional redesign — was therefore true of the DECLARATIONS and false of the RUNTIME. This artifact moves it into the runtime and makes the move measurable.
$not_a_second_authority: This is not a second kernel, a second registry or a second existence vocabulary. It does not re-declare a contradiction form (engine/ceu/catalog.py already registers one), does not re-declare existence or epistemic states (SEED_EXISTENCE_STATES, SEED_EPISTEMIC_STATES already do), does not mint identifiers (engine/uckp/identity.py and engine/registry/universal/identity.py already do), and does not re-implement the canonical digest (engine/uckp/canonical.py already does). Every reality state below either NAMES the UCOS-CEU-001 row it derives from or discloses that no row exists and why. Law UCON-L-14 imports the CEU seeds and refuses a binding CEU does not carry, so this file cannot drift into a private copy of somebody else's vocabulary.

principle.statement: The system shall remain permanently capable of representing, governing, verifying, tracing, researching, evolving and integrating any presented construct — including constructs that are unknown, undiscovered, hypothetical, contradictory, unverified, undecidable, unobservable, future-originated, or currently unrepresentable within existing frameworks — without constitutional redesign.
principle.$enforcement: The two lists above are not decoration. 'admission_does_not_imply' is enforced by the conjunction in reality.permits(): an operational act is permitted only when BOTH the active disposition and the active reality state permit it. ADMIT permits certify; HYPOTHETICAL does not; so an admitted hypothetical construct cannot be certified, and law UCON-L-11 proves it by exercising the whole disposition x reality cross-product rather than asserting it.
refused_claims: an upper bound on the number of constructs, kinds, dispositions, reality states, ontologies, verifiers, axes or temporal systems
principle.$refused_claims_are_measured: Law UCON-L-13 scans this module for the permanence and completeness vocabulary these claims would require, and refuses any occurrence outside a declared preserved site. The absence of the claim is a ratchet, not a promise.

$claim_scan.$phrases: The vocabulary an unverifiable guarantee would have to use. Scanned across this capability's own source on every run by law UCON-L-13. The phrases live HERE, in data, and never in engine/construct/*.py — which is why the detector cannot match its own source and needs no exemption for itself.
$claim_scan.$preserved_sites: Empty, and it is a ratchet rather than a boast: a legitimate future occurrence is admitted by declaring it here with its reason, and an undeclared occurrence closes the gate. A site declared here whose occurrence has since gone is also a failure, so the list cannot rot.

operational_acts.definition: Name the construct, read it, and trace it. Never withheld: withholding it would make a governed record unreadable, which is indistinguishable from having dropped it.
Declare a dependency edge onto the construct, so another construct's correctness rests on it.
Produce a new construct whose lineage names this one. Permitted for hypotheses and unknowns, because research is derivation from what is not yet known.
Assert the construct as certified truth. Requires both a disposition and a reality state that permit it — this is the act 'admission does not imply truth' is about.
Present the construct outside the governed boundary as a finding.
Let the construct drive behaviour — run it, apply it, or enforce it.

dispositions.title: Admitted to governed representation
dispositions.definition: The construct is represented, traceable and available to the acts its reality state also permits. It is not thereby true.

dispositions.title: Requires transformation before admission
dispositions.definition: The construct is representable only after a declared transformation — most commonly the registration of its classifying kind, which is one governed act, never a code change.

dispositions.title: Referred to research
dispositions.definition: The construct is not decidable on present evidence and becomes the subject of a research construct. This is the disposition that makes an unknown productive rather than discarded.

dispositions.title: Quarantined
dispositions.definition: The construct is retained and readable but may not be depended on, derived from, certified, published or executed. Contradiction and unattributed provenance land here — retained because discarding a contradiction destroys the evidence that a contradiction exists.

dispositions.title: Deferred pending a dependency
dispositions.definition: A named prerequisite is unresolved. Deferral records what is being waited for, so a wait cannot become a silent drop.

dispositions.title: Escalated to an authority
dispositions.definition: No declared rule decides this construct, or the presenter asked for an authority. This is the catch-all, and it is deliberately non-destructive: an unmatched construct is a gap in the rule set, and the honest answer is 'an authority must decide', never 'discard'.

dispositions.title: Undecidable under the present framework
dispositions.definition: No decision procedure available to the present framework decides this construct. Non-terminal on purpose: a future framework may decide what this one cannot, and a terminal UNDECIDABLE would be a claim about all future frameworks.

dispositions.title: Rejected
dispositions.definition: The construct is refused the operational acts beyond reference. It is still REPRESENTED — the record of the rejection, its rule and its rationale is retained, because a rejection that leaves no record is indistinguishable from a construct that was silently ignored. Non-terminal: new evidence readmits.

$dispositions: Open by registration, not by enumeration: engine/construct/extension.py::register_disposition admits a new disposition as a construct of kind 'disposition', and law UCON-L-09 exercises that admission in memory on every run. The eight above are the declared MINIMUM, and 'closed_set' is false in every document this capability emits.

reality_states.title: Verified
reality_states.definition: Independently confirmed against a declared verifier, with the verifier's own assumptions and limitations recorded.

reality_states.title: Reproduced
reality_states.definition: Observed more than once, by more than one source, with agreeing results.

reality_states.title: Observed
reality_states.definition: One observation is recorded. Not reproduced, so not certifiable.

reality_states.title: Theoretical
reality_states.definition: Derived from a model that is itself governed. No observation is claimed.

reality_states.title: Hypothetical
reality_states.definition: Entertained without commitment. The state a research object starts in.

reality_states.title: Contradicted
reality_states.definition: Confirmed claims about this construct conflict, and the conflict stands unresolved. Retained, never deleted: the contradiction is the evidence.

reality_states.title: Unknown
reality_states.definition: Nothing is established. A state, not an absence, and not a failure.

reality_states.title: Undecidable
reality_states.definition: No decision procedure available to the present framework settles the question. Distinct from UNKNOWN, which is an absence of evidence, and distinct from the CEU row 'impossible', which is exclusion by a stated constraint.

binding_gap.finding: UCOS-CEU-001 declares no epistemic row for 'no decision procedure exists'. Its nearest row, 'impossible', means excluded by a stated constraint, which is a different claim: an undecidable proposition is not excluded, it is unsettleable by the present framework.
binding_gap.remediation: CEU registers an 'undecidable' epistemic row, after which this binding is declared and the gap closes. Until then the state is declared here and its lack of a CEU row is disclosed rather than papered over with the wrong row.

$reality_states: Reality status is independent of disposition by construction, not by convention. No reality state is terminal (law UCON-L-10): VERIFIED names CONTRADICTED among its successors, because falsification must remain reachable from every state including the strongest one. A framework in which VERIFIED were terminal would be asserting that some verification can never be overturned.
$initial_reality_state: The state a construct is in before any evidence is assessed. It is declared rather than defaulted in code, because 'what do we assume when we know nothing' is exactly the kind of assumption that must not be silent. UNKNOWN is chosen because it is a state and not an absence: assuming HYPOTHETICAL would attribute a hypothesis nobody made, and assuming THEORETICAL would attribute a model nobody declared.

none.definition: The default. A construct carries a payload the foundation does not interpret.

kind.definition: The reflective facet: a construct that declares a new construct kind.

unknown.definition: An unknown as a first-class governed object: what is not known, in which domain, stated precisely enough to be researched.

contradiction.definition: A contradiction as a first-class governed object. 'left' and 'right' name the constructs that conflict; neither is deleted.

research.definition: A research object. Confidence is a reference to a UCXI KNOWLEDGE context, never a number invented here.

discovery.definition: A governed discovery object: a named opportunity with a declared priority and impact.

verifier.definition: A verifier as a governed construct. 'assumptions' and 'limitations' are REQUIRED: a verifier that declares neither cannot be verified, and law UCON-L-12 refuses it.

extension.definition: An extension of a governed framework — an ontology, a governance rule, a location axis, a temporal system, an identity namespace.

construct_kinds.$openness: This list is a SEED, not a universe. engine/construct/registry.py derives the set of registered kinds from what has been registered and consults no table, exactly as engine/kernel/registry.py::metatype_exists does. 'construct-kind' classifies itself, which is the fixed point that makes registration the only extension mechanism.
construct_kinds.$seed_reality_state: The reality state a declared seed kind is presented in. It is declared rather than written into engine/construct/registry.py because 'how real is a kind we declared' is a claim, and claims belong in the declaration. OBSERVED is correct and deliberately modest: one source — this declaration — records the kind. It is not REPRODUCED, because a second independent source has not declared it, and it is not VERIFIED, because nothing independently confirmed it.

seed.title: Construct Kind
seed.definition: The reflective root. A kind is itself a construct, so declaring a new category is one governed registration and never an edit to this foundation.

seed.title: Entity
seed.definition: A thing that is.

seed.title: Concept
seed.definition: A thing that is thought.

seed.title: Relationship
seed.definition: A thing that holds between things.

seed.title: Structure
seed.definition: An arrangement of things.

seed.title: Capability
seed.definition: Something a system can do.

seed.title: Ontology
seed.definition: A governed account of what kinds of things there are. An ontology is a construct, so an ontology may declare an ontology.

seed.title: Taxonomy
seed.definition: A governed classification within an ontology.

seed.title: Governance Model
seed.definition: A governed account of how decisions are made. Governance is a construct, so governance is governable.

seed.title: Governance Rule
seed.definition: One enforceable rule within a governance model.

seed.title: Verifier
seed.definition: A mechanism that decides whether something holds. A verifier is a construct, so verification is verifiable.

seed.title: Intelligence Model
seed.definition: A governed account of how a system knows and decides.

seed.title: Mathematics Model
seed.definition: A governed account of a mathematical structure or system.

seed.title: Physics Model
seed.definition: A governed account of physical law.

seed.title: Computation Model
seed.definition: A governed account of what may be computed and how.

seed.title: Knowledge Model
seed.definition: A governed account of how knowledge is formed, held and superseded.

seed.title: Reality Model
seed.definition: A governed account of what is the case, and in which reality.

seed.title: Temporal Model
seed.definition: A governed account of time. Delegates every coordinate to CMG-000002.

seed.title: Temporal System
seed.definition: One declared reference system a temporal coordinate resolves through — Earth, Mars, lunar, mission-elapsed, logical, or unknown.

seed.title: Location Model
seed.definition: A governed account of where. Delegates every frame to UCXI-000001.

seed.title: Location Axis
seed.definition: One axis a reference frame may declare — universe, reality, galaxy, system, planet, region, coordinate framework, or an axis nobody has needed yet.

seed.title: Economic Model
seed.definition: A governed account of value and exchange.

seed.title: Identity Model
seed.definition: A governed account of who or what something is. Delegates minting to UCKP-ART-05.

seed.title: Identity Namespace
seed.definition: One declared naming authority within an identity model. Federated by construction: a namespace names its parent authority, so no single authority is assumed.

seed.title: Unknown
seed.definition: Something not known, registered so that it is governed rather than merely absent.

seed.title: Question
seed.definition: An unresolved question — an unknown stated interrogatively.

seed.title: Contradiction
seed.definition: Two governed claims that cannot both hold. Registered, retained and traceable.

seed.title: Research Object
seed.definition: A hypothesis under investigation, with its evidence, findings, open questions and future work.

seed.title: Discovery Object
seed.definition: A governed discovery opportunity with priority, impact and evidence gaps.

seed.title: Disposition
seed.definition: A disposition is a construct, which is what makes the disposition set open by registration rather than fixed by this file.

seed.title: Reality State
seed.definition: A reality state is a construct, which is what makes the reality vocabulary open by registration.

seed.title: Future Unknown Model
seed.definition: The declared placeholder for a category nobody has yet conceived. It exists so that 'we did not anticipate this' is a registration and not a redesign — and it is deliberately NOT a fallback: nothing is classified into it automatically, because a default bucket is how an unclassifiable construct stops being visible.

construct_kinds.$registration_dispositions: The dispositions under which a registration of a construct kind takes EFFECT. Declared here because it was previously a disposition name written into engine/construct/registry.py, which is precisely the closure this capability exists to inventory. ADMIT alone is correct and deliberately strict: a kind registration that was itself told to TRANSFORM has not happened yet, and one that was QUARANTINED — because a contradiction names it — must stop being effective until the contradiction is dispositioned. The consequence is intended: instances of a kind whose registration is quarantined revert to TRANSFORM rather than continuing to admit.

unknown_classes.$openness: Open by registration. A class this list does not name is registered as a construct of kind 'construct-kind' with facet 'unknown', never added by editing an enum. Law UCON-L-08 exercises that path in memory on every run.

seed.definition: A mathematical structure, object or result that is not established.
A physical law, quantity or mechanism that is not established.
A category of thing for which no governed account exists.
A mode of knowing or deciding that is not characterised.
A way decisions could be made that is not characterised.
A candidate account of what is the case, not established.
A candidate account of time, not established.
A candidate account of where, not established.
A candidate account of computation, not established.
A form knowledge could take that is not characterised.
A candidate account of value and exchange, not established.
A candidate account of identity, not established.
A domain that does not yet exist as a domain.

An unknown whose class is itself unknown. Declared explicitly so that a second-order unknown has a home, and NOT used as a fallback: the disposition engine escalates rather than classifying here silently.

contradiction_classes.$openness: Open by registration, on the same path as unknown_classes.

seed.definition: The two claims cannot both be true under the declared logic.
Two bodies of evidence support incompatible conclusions.
Two authorities have decided the same question differently.
The claims are incompatible only under a shared temporal frame, and the frames differ.
The claims are incompatible only when translated between frameworks, and the translation is itself contested.
Two measurements of the same quantity disagree beyond their declared uncertainty.
A conflict is established but its class is not. Declared so that 'we know these conflict but not why' is recordable.

resolution_states.definition: Registered, unresolved, and lawful to leave unresolved.
A research construct derives from this contradiction.
One side was superseded by a declared authority. The superseded side is retained.
The conflict dissolved under a newly declared framework or temporal frame.
No decision procedure available to the present framework resolves it.

contradiction_classes.$contradicting: 'contradicting' is what makes a resolution state operational rather than descriptive: a contradiction in a contradicting state quarantines the constructs it names, and one in a non-contradicting state does not. Declaring the flag here is what keeps that decision out of engine/construct/registry.py, where it would have been an undeclared policy embedded in a membership test.

research_states.definition: The hypothesis is stated and no work has begun.
Evidence exists and has not yet been evaluated.
Findings exist. They may support, refute or fail to settle the hypothesis.
The hypothesis was refuted. A refutation is a finding, not a failure, and the object is retained.
The hypothesis is supported. Support is not certification; certification requires a reality state that permits it.
The evidence does not settle the hypothesis, and it is not undecidable either.
No decision procedure available to the present framework settles the hypothesis.
A later research object supersedes this one. Retained for lineage.

priority_scale.definition: Blocks a governed decision within the current programme.
Priority not established. Declared so that an unprioritised opportunity is visible rather than absent.

impact_scale.definition: Would change what the system may represent.
Would change how the system is built.
Would change how the system runs.

sources.opportunity: An unknown is registered and no research or discovery construct derives from it.
sources.definition: Every registered unknown is a discovery opportunity. This is the source that makes 'unknowns automatically become research objects' a mechanism rather than an instruction.

sources.opportunity: A contradiction stands and nothing derives from it.
sources.definition: A contradiction that nobody is investigating is the highest-value discovery in the system: two governed claims are known to conflict and the conflict is unattended.

sources.opportunity: A construct reached the catch-all, so no declared rule decided it.
sources.definition: An escalation is evidence of a gap in the rule set itself, which is why its impact is constitutional: the question is not what to do with this construct but why the governance had nothing to say about it.

sources.opportunity: A construct is undecidable under the present framework.
sources.definition: Recorded as a discovery rather than closed, because a future framework may decide what this one cannot. P2 rather than P0: undecidability is a known limit, not a surprise.

sources.opportunity: A construct names a dependency no registered construct satisfies.
sources.definition: The dependency may be future, may be misnamed, or may belong to an owner who has not presented it. All three are discoveries; none is a defect that should be silently tolerated.

sources.opportunity: A construct was presented without the fields its facet requires.
sources.definition: Recorded rather than refused at presentation, so the attempt remains visible. The discovery is what the presenter was unable to supply.

$selectors.$two_way_binding: Refused in both directions at load by Declaration.validate, on the same terms as the disposition operators: a source naming an unimplemented selector is manual discovery, and an implemented selector no source claims is a discovery path nothing walks.

discovery.$derived_key_prefixes: Derived natural keys are declared so that idempotence is a property of the declaration rather than of a string literal in the engine. Promotion and discovery both mint a natural key from the subject's identity, so the identifier is a function of what the object is ABOUT — which is what makes running discovery twice mint nothing the second time (law UCON-L-07).

disposition_rules.$totality: Ordered, first-match-wins, and the LAST rule must be the catch-all. Law UCON-L-02 refuses a rule set whose last member is not marked catch_all, refuses a catch_all anywhere but last, and refuses more than one. This is what makes disposition a TOTAL function rather than a lookup that can miss.
disposition_rules.$catch_all_is_escalate: The catch-all disposition is ESCALATE, and law UCON-L-03 refuses any other. A catch-all of REJECT would silently discard exactly the constructs the rule set failed to anticipate, which is the failure mode this whole artifact exists to prevent.

rules.rationale: The presenter asked for an authority. Honouring that is cheaper than discovering later that a rule decided something a human meant to decide.
A presenter or verifier states that no decision procedure available to the present framework applies. Recording that is more useful than forcing a verdict the framework cannot support.

A registered contradiction names this construct. It is retained and readable and may not be depended on, derived from, certified, published or executed until the contradiction is dispositioned. Discarding it would destroy the evidence that the contradiction exists.
The classifying kind is not registered. The transformation is one governed registration, never a schema change — which is precisely why an unregistered kind is TRANSFORM and not REJECT.
An unknown is productive, not defective. Every unknown-kinded construct becomes the subject of a research construct.
A research object whose work is unfinished stays in research. Promoting it on the strength of a partial evidence set is how an unfinished investigation becomes a claim.
A named prerequisite is absent from the registry. Deferral records what is being waited for.
A construct whose origin cannot be attributed is retained and readable but may not be depended on. Rejecting it would lose the record that an unattributable construct was presented.
Nothing is established and no evidence is offered. That is a research subject, not a verdict.

Evidence is offered and no prior rule objected. Admission is governed representation and nothing more: what the construct may then DO is decided by the conjunction of this disposition and its reality state.
No declared rule decided this construct. That is a gap in the rule set, and the honest disposition is that an authority must decide. This rule is why no presented construct can be silently ignored.

$operators.$two_way_binding: Law UCON-L-04 refuses in both directions: a rule naming an operator OPERATORS does not implement is manual governance, and an operator OPERATORS implements that no rule claims is dead code wearing an engine's costume. Both are hard failures, so the claimed list above cannot drift from either the rules or the source.

disposition_rules.$catch_all_disposition: The disposition the catch-all rule must assign. Declared so that law UCON-L-03 measures the rule against a stated expectation rather than against a literal in its own source: editing UCON-DR-11 to REJECT then fails the law instead of silently changing what happens to every construct the rule set failed to anticipate. The law also measures a structural half that no declaration can fake — the catch-all disposition must be non-terminal and must reach every other declared disposition in one step, so falling through forecloses nothing.

extension_points.$principle: Every self-extension in this capability travels the SAME path — register a construct — so there is one extension mechanism to verify rather than nine. Each point below names the owner it extends, the construct kind that carries the extension, and the law that exercises the admission in memory on every run.
extension_points.$probe_key_prefix: Every extension exercised in memory by law UCON-L-09 carries this prefix on its natural key, so a probe can never be mistaken for a governed registration and a probe that leaked into a persisted record is identifiable by inspection. The prefix is declared rather than written into engine/construct/extension.py so that the collision-safety property is a property of the declaration.

$admissions.$two_way_binding: Refused in both directions at load, on the same terms as the operators and selectors: a point naming an unimplemented admission is an extension path that cannot be walked, and an implemented admission no point claims is an extension path nothing exercises.

audit.$standing: MEASURE FIRST. This section configures an inventory, not a migration. Nothing in engine/construct/audit.py edits, rewrites or migrates any closure mechanism it finds; it reads, counts, classifies and reports. The ratchet below is what keeps the inventory honest between runs.

closure_forms.detection: a ClassDef whose bases include Enum, IntEnum, StrEnum, Flag or IntFlag
closure_forms.limitation: A member set fixed in source. A future member is a code edit, a release and a migration of every persisted value.
closure_forms.migration: Move the member set to a declaration and derive membership from a registry, keeping the enum only where the vocabulary is a closed internal state machine the code branches on exhaustively.

closure_forms.detection: a module-level UPPER_SNAKE assignment whose value is a frozenset(...) call or a set literal
closure_forms.limitation: A membership test against a fixed population. Extension requires a source edit.
closure_forms.migration: Read the population from the owner's declaration; keep the constant as a cache of what was read.

closure_forms.detection: a module-level UPPER_SNAKE assignment whose value is a tuple of constants or of constant tuples
closure_forms.limitation: An ordered fixed vocabulary, frequently a seed table. Benign when the runtime does not consult it after seeding; a closure when it is the authority.
closure_forms.migration: Establish whether the runtime consults it after seeding. If it does, move it to a declaration; if it does not, disclose it as a seed.

closure_forms.detection: a module-level UPPER_SNAKE assignment whose value is a dict literal
closure_forms.limitation: A fixed dispatch table. The set of behaviours the module can perform is decided in source, so a new behaviour is a code change.
closure_forms.migration: Where the table maps a declared name to an implementation, bind it two-way to the declaration so neither side can drift; where it maps data to data, move it to a declaration.

closure_forms.detection: a comparison of the form len(X) == N, or a name containing 'count' compared to an integer literal
closure_forms.limitation: An assertion that a population has exactly N members. A new member breaks it, which is the good case; the bad case is when it silently pins a vocabulary.
closure_forms.migration: Assert a floor or a declared expectation rather than an exact count, or derive N from the declaration.

risk_tiers.definition: The closure decides what the system may represent. A new member cannot be added without a constitutional amendment.
risk_tiers.criterion: the module is named by a declared constitutional owner

risk_tiers.definition: The closure decides how a capability is built. A new member requires a code change plus a migration.
risk_tiers.criterion: the closure is consulted by more than one package

risk_tiers.definition: The closure is internal to one module and a new member is a local edit.
risk_tiers.criterion: the closure is consulted only within its own module

risk_tiers.definition: The closure is intentional and disclosed, with a named closing invariant and an amendment path.
risk_tiers.criterion: the closure appears in disclosed_closures with intentional true

audit.$risk_assignment: Risk is DECLARED per module prefix below, never inferred from a keyword. An inferred tier would manufacture the classification the audit is supposed to measure. A module prefix this list does not name yields tier R3-LOCAL and is counted in the backlog, which is the conservative answer rather than a flattering one.
audit.$deliberate_tier: The tier a DISCLOSED, intentional closure takes, whatever its module prefix says. Declared because the R4 criterion is a property of the disclosure rather than of the module, and because assigning disclosed closures their prefix tier instead would leave R4 permanently empty — a declared tier nothing can ever occupy is a closure in the risk model itself.
audit.$undeclared_tier: The tier a module takes when no declared prefix claims it. Declared here rather than defaulted in engine/construct/audit.py because 'what do we assume about code nobody has classified' is an assumption, and an unnamed assumption in a risk classifier is how a constitutional closure comes to be counted as a local one. R3-LOCAL is the conservative choice for a RATCHET — it keeps the closure counted in the backlog without asserting an owner the declaration does not name.
audit.$governed_scope: The scope in which an undisclosed closure is a VIOLATION rather than a backlog entry. It began as exactly this capability, because a capability that ratchets everybody else's code before its own has inverted the obligation. Widening this list is how the audit converts backlog into enforcement, one owner at a time, and each widening is a decision with a named owner rather than a sweep. FIRST WIDENING: engine/recursive_knowledge/ (owner URKE-000001), admitted after UCON-000001 had already ratcheted its own eight closures, so the obligation is discharged before it is extended. The widening was not a convenience: URKE-000001 authored four closures outside governed scope, which the ratchet correctly refused as a population increase over the declared baseline. Enforcing disclosure on them is the honest remedy; raising the baseline to accommodate them would have been the dishonest one, and this declaration forbids it.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The predicate primitives a declared rule may use. Closed in source and TWO-WAY BOUND to disposition_rules by law UCON-L-04: a rule naming an absent operator and an operator no rule claims are both hard failures, so neither side can drift from the other.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the predicate here and declare a rule that uses it. Both halves are required, which is the intended cost: an operator is executable governance and must not be addable by data alone.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The selectors a declared discovery source may use. Two-way bound to discovery.sources at load, on the same terms as OPERATORS.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the selector here and declare a discovery source that claims it.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The admission paths an extension point may name. Two-way bound to extension_points.points at load; every entry is exercised in memory on every run by law UCON-L-09.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the admission here and declare an extension point that names it.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The closure forms this audit can detect. Two-way bound to audit.closure_forms at load. Deliberately self-referential: this very table is one of the closures the audit reports, which is what makes the audit subject to its own measurement.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the detector here and declare the closure form, its limitation and its migration path.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The implemented law checks. Two-way bound to laws by Declaration.validate: a law naming an unimplemented check is manual governance, and a check no law claims is dead code that looks like enforcement.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the check here and declare the law that claims it.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The Python base names that make a class a closed enumeration. Closed because the Python language closes it: this is a fact about the standard library's enum module, not a UCOS vocabulary.
disclosed_closures.admission: The standard library introduces a new enumeration base, after which it is added here. There is no governed decision to make.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: A structural arity check on a Python AST assignment node, not a population pin. The audit measures single-target module-level assignments; this comparison is how it recognises one, and it asserts nothing about how many targets Python permits.
disclosed_closures.admission: None is needed, and that is the disclosure. This is a declared FALSE POSITIVE of the POPULATION_ASSERTION detector, retained rather than suppressed: narrowing the detector so that it stopped matching here would also stop it matching the real population pins it exists to find, and rewriting the comparison to evade its own detector would be the audit gaming itself. disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The thirty-two implemented URKE law checks, mapped to the check that measures each declared law. Closed in source and two-way bound to URKE-000001's declared laws: contract.available_checks() publishes the implemented set and the declaration is validated against it, so a law naming an unimplemented check is manual governance wearing a law's name, and a check no law claims is dead code that looks like enforcement. Both directions are refused at load, so neither side can drift.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the check here and declare the law in urke-declaration.json that claims it. Both halves are required, which is the intended cost: a law check is executable governance and must not be addable by data alone.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The admission names URKE-L-09 exercises when it proves that admitting members nobody declared moves no byte of the package. FORWARD-BOUND ONLY: every member must be an exercisable admission, and admission.exercise refuses a name it does not implement, so the tuple cannot name a fiction. It is a probe vocabulary rather than an authority — no runtime behaviour is dispatched through it, and deleting a member weakens a law's coverage without changing what the capability can represent.
disclosed_closures.admission: Implement the admission in engine/recursive_knowledge/admission.py and add its name here so URKE-L-09 exercises it.
disclosed_closures.gap: The reverse binding does not hold. admission.available_admissions() publishes fourteen admissions and _OPENNESS names thirteen: 'admit_architecture_proposal' is implemented and exercisable but is not exercised by URKE-L-09, so the openness law under-covers its own subject by one member and nothing refuses that. Measured during UCON-000001 closure attribution, not asserted from prose. Remediation: bind _OPENNESS two-way to admission.available_admissions() so an implemented admission that no openness probe exercises is refused at load, in the same manner as UCON-CL-09 and UCON-CL-10. Owner URKE-000001. Disclosed here rather than silently corrected, because editing another owner's source to make this audit's disclosure look complete would be the audit gaming itself.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The locator strategies a declared discovery rule may name. The same closure on the same grounds as UCON-CL-05 in this capability; one-way binding is the BC-1 shape, where the register declared R-01..R-09, the predicates implemented R-01..R-08, and classify() returned ERROR for every subject.

Closed in source because a ratcheted measurement whose ceiling could be introduced by data alone would let a new debt class arrive already capped. Bound in both directions: `_ratcheted` refuses a measurement with no declared ceiling, and UEC-L-11 refuses a ceiling above the measurement, so neither the code nor the declaration can carry a ratchet the other does not.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The fields excluded from UEC's certification identity, each mapped to the reason it cannot change a verdict. Closed in source DELIBERATELY, and it is the inverse of the usual closure argument: inclusion in the identity is the default, so this table is the complete enumeration of exemptions rather than of admissions. `_check_digest_exclusions` refuses an exclusion naming a field the declaration does not carry, so the list cannot silently widen when a field is renamed. Measured against the defect it answers: `engine/construct/declaration.py:digest_payload` includes a chosen projection with its exclusions undocumented, and flipping `blocking` on UCON-L-01 leaves declaration_digest byte-identical while contract.py:1018 makes the verdict depend on it.
disclosed_closures.admission: Add the field name here together with a stated reason it cannot alter any verdict, and prove it in test_enforcement_closure.py — a mutation of the field must NOT move the digest. Excluding a field that can change a verdict is refused by the mutation suite.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The three source spellings that constitute a certification identity — `content_hash` (Layer Zero), a bare `sha256`, and a local `digest`/`seal` helper. Closed DELIBERATELY: this repository mints digests three ways, and a detector recognising only one of them would report a false absence for two thirds of the surface, which is worse than no measurement because it would name innocent packages.
disclosed_closures.admission: Add the spelling here. No declaration change is required — this is a heuristic over source text rather than a governed vocabulary, which is why the closure is disclosed WITH a standing gap rather than presented as complete.
disclosed_closures.gap: UEC-L-08 measures only the NECESSARY condition — that a certification identity exists somewhere in the consuming package. It does NOT measure the SUFFICIENT condition, that every semantic edit moves it. A fourth digest spelling would be missed until added here, and a package that mints a digest it never applies to its declaration would pass. `engine/construct` passes UEC-L-08 and still carries the defect proven by execution: flipping `blocking` on UCON-L-01 leaves declaration_digest at 192c63af… byte-identical while contract.py:1018 makes the verdict depend on it. The sufficient condition is measured by mutation for UEC's own declaration only (test_enforcement_closure.py::test_every_semantic_mutation_moves_the_certification_identity) and for none of the other eighteen. Recorded as an open gap rather than closed by a green tick.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The parsed fields deliberately outside this declaration's certification identity. Closed in source BY DESIGN and in the safe direction: the digest INCLUDES every field of `Declaration` by default (derived from `dataclasses.fields`), so this table can only ever REMOVE coverage, never add it, and each entry must state why the field cannot reach a verdict. Two-way bound by `test_construct_foundation.py`, which fails on an undeclared omission in one direction and on an exclusion naming a field this declaration no longer has in the other. This table exists because the OPPOSITE convention — a hand-listed inclusion projection — is the measured defect it replaced: eleven keys were listed, ten collapsed to bare identifiers, and flipping `blocking` on UCON-L-01 left the digest byte-identical at 192c63af while the verdict depended on it.
disclosed_closures.admission: Add the field name here WITH the reason it cannot alter a verdict, and the suite will hold you to it in both directions. Deliberately expensive: an entry here removes a value from the identity that certifies this programme, so it is a governance act rather than a data edit.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The same construct as UCON's, over URKE's declaration, and closed on the same terms: inclusion is the default over all 115 parsed fields and this table only subtracts. It replaced a thirteen-key inclusion projection under which flipping `blocking` on URKE-L-01 left the digest byte-identical at af30af45 while `contract.py` chose OPEN or CLOSED from that flag, and under which 101 of 115 parsed fields were outside the identity entirely.
disclosed_closures.admission: Add the field name here with the reason it cannot alter a verdict. `test_recursive_knowledge.py` refuses a stale exclusion, so the disclosure cannot outlive the field it describes.

disclosed_closures.closing_invariant: The generic semantic mutations UEC-L-13 applies to every governed declaration exposing the uniform identity interface. Closed in source on purpose: a mutation set that could be EXTENDED BY DATA would let the subject of a measurement choose the measurement, which is the certification bypass this law exists to refuse. Each entry targets a value a programme's own contract reads to reach a verdict — a law's blocking flag, its statement, its bound check, the declared authority, the declared version — so a surviving mutant is a demonstrated bypass rather than a theoretical one. Non-vacuity is held by the ratchet `declarations_with_uniform_identity`, which fails in BOTH directions.
disclosed_closures.admission: Add the mutation here, in code, alongside a test that proves it kills on a forged incomplete identity. Adding one is intended to be a source change reviewed as governance: the set is the definition of 'semantic', and widening it silently by data would make the law mean whatever the last edit said it meant.

baseline.$definition: The closure population measured outside governed_scope at the moment this declaration was authored. It is a RATCHET: the audit fails when the population outside governed scope EXCEEDS the baseline, and the baseline is lowered — never raised — as owners close their own closures. It is not a target, and it certifies nothing about the closures it counts.
baseline.$why_a_ratchet_and_not_a_gate: A gate demanding zero closures today would be closed on the day it was written and would then be disabled, which is worse than a ratchet that holds. UISD-000001 §ISD-L-07 established the pattern in this repository: a detector that cannot pass is a detector that gets removed.

laws.statement: Every presented construct is recorded and carries exactly one active disposition.
The disposition rule set is total: exactly one catch-all rule exists and it is last.
The catch-all disposition is non-destructive — it is ESCALATE, never REJECT.
Every declared operator is implemented and every implemented operator is claimed by a rule.
No presented construct is dropped: the registry population equals the presented population, whatever the dispositions were.
Unknowns, contradictions, research objects and discovery objects are representable, and every unknown is transformable into a research object.
Recursive discovery reaches a fixed point: discovery run twice over one state mints nothing new.
A future kind is admissible by registration alone — the foundation's source is unchanged by admitting a category it has never seen.
Every declared extension point is exercisable: the admission is performed in memory and the framework it extends still answers.
No disposition and no reality state is terminal, and every reality state is reachable from UNKNOWN.
Reality status is independent of disposition: the whole cross-product is representable, and neither module derives the other.
A verifier declares its own assumptions and limitations, and a verifier that declares neither is refused.
This capability declares no permanence and no completeness over unknown constructs.
Every reality state binds to a UCOS-CEU-001 row that CEU actually carries, or discloses that no row exists and why.
The closure inventory holds: no undisclosed closure inside governed scope, and the population outside it does not exceed the declared baseline.
The foundation is deterministic and writes nothing: two measurements of one state produce identical bytes.

$law_checks: engine/construct/contract.py::LAW_CHECKS. The binding is two-way (engine/construct/model.py::Declaration.validate): a law naming a check that is not implemented is manual governance, and a check that is implemented but no law claims is dead code that looks like enforcement. Both are refused at load, so the live path is never the unmeasured one.

self_application.$statement: The foundation is a construct. Its kinds, dispositions, reality states, verifier and laws are constructs of the kinds it declares, admitted through the registry it provides and disposed by the engine it implements. Law UCON-L-09 exercises that on every run.
self_application.identity_plane: urn:ucos:ucko:<namespace>:<local_name> — derived through engine/uckp/identity.py. This capability mints no identifier of its own and holds no counter.

$namespace_disclosure.finding: 'ucos.construct' is not among the declared namespaces in 00-MASTER/UOBC-000001/uobc-birth-contract.json::namespace_policy.declared_namespaces, whose own $open_world note states that an unlisted namespace is refused by the gate and that admitting one is an edit to that file.
$namespace_disclosure.remediation: UOBC declares the namespace, after which constructs minted by this capability carry birth records under it. Until then this capability derives identity for in-memory constructs and registers no birth record, which is why it appears in no birth ledger and claims no birth.

evidence.$home: Untracked by design. Evidence here is a RECORD of a measurement, never Repository Truth, and deleting the whole directory changes no verdict.

records.content: the full measurement: every law, every refusal, the registry summary, the disposition distribution and the closure inventory summary
the complete extensibility audit inventory — every located closure with its module, symbol, form, tier, owner, limitation and migration path

gate.$exit_codes: 'A law was measured and refused' and 'no verdict could be reached' are different facts. Collapsing them would let an unreadable declaration pass as whichever was more convenient.
gate.writes: nothing unless --evidence is passed, and then only under evidence.home
gate.verify_stage_label: universal construct foundation (UCON-000001, every construct disposed and nothing silently ignored)
